act: IOI Corporation Berhad: Foreign Workers Recruitment Guideline & Procedure in Malaysia
act_en: IOI Corporation Berhad: Foreign Workers Recruitment Guideline & Procedure in Malaysia
heading: No recruitment fee policy
text: 4.2 “No Recruitment Fee” Policy IOI Group practices a “No Recruitment Fee” policy in recruiting its foreign workers. IOI Group covers the official cost of recruiting foreign workers, as shown in Appendix B. Any other costs not listed therein shall not be charged to the workers, and should they be, will be handled according to 6.3.
amendment_notes: Foreign Workers Recruitment Guideline & Procedure in Malaysia, published Q4 2017 by the company itself. Quoted as published; it says what the company promises, not what it does.

act: IOI Corporation Berhad: Foreign Workers Recruitment Guideline & Procedure in Malaysia
act_en: IOI Corporation Berhad: Foreign Workers Recruitment Guideline & Procedure in Malaysia
heading: Enforcement of the no recruitment fee policy
text: 6.3 Policy enforcement According to IOI’s “No Recruitment Fee” policy stated in this document (see Section 4.2), where recruited foreign workers are concerned, no recruitment fees, including any fees incurred to them at any stage of the recruitment process, whether by us, our contractors, our agents or their sub-agents in receiving and sending countries will be charged to them. www.ioigroup.com Recruitment agencies are responsible for monitoring their possible sub-agencies to make sure that they follow these guidelines and do not charge any recruitment related fees from the workers. If such fees are found to be charged to the workers, IOI will require the recruitment agency to repay the workers. If such an action has not been undertaken by the recruitment agency, IOI will suspend any relationship with the agency until the matter is rectified. The Group will terminate all contract or partnership with any recruitment agency that is found to be non-compliant with the Group’s policies after the necessary investigations and warnings.

heading: Passport handling
text: 7.5 Passport handling In accordance with the Group’s passport safekeeping guidelines, the workers are free to decide how and where they want their passports to be kept. They can either: a) Keep their passports themselves; b) Have their passports kept in a centralised passport lockers provided by the management, to which workers have 24-hour access

heading: Grievance mechanism
text: 7.9 Grievance mechanism In line with the Group’s SPOP, the workers have the right to freedom of association and are provided with a channel to voice out their grievances. The Group is committed to an open and transparent approach to resolve outstanding grievances with the involvement of affected stakeholders.
